response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(GOT - GPT) AS avg_ast_alt, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5 GROUP BY CENTROMEA) SELECT AVG(avg_ast_alt) AS ast_minus_alt, AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM per_status;

assumptions.assumption: WBC >= 6.5 is inclusive, and records with a NULL WBC are excluded.
A missing anti-centromere status means SQL NULL. GROUP BY CENTROMEA puts all NULLs in one group. Empty or blank strings are treated as their own status, not as missing.

A per-record difference is skipped when either operand is NULL, because AVG ignores NULL inputs. A status group whose average for one metric is NULL is left out of that metric's outer average, so each status counts equally.

alternatives.interpretation: Blank or whitespace-only CENTROMEA values also count as missing and go into the same group as NULL.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CENTROMEA), ''), 'missing') AS status, AVG(GOT - GPT) AS avg_ast_alt, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_pt FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5 GROUP BY status) SELECT AVG(avg_ast_alt) AS ast_minus_alt, AVG(avg_aptt_pt) AS aptt_minus_pt FROM per_status;
